content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is there a source for images and GIFs, such as those for buttons and lamps, suitable for use in HMI or web editor projects? I find that the default library provided with the installed web editor is rather limited. Best regards,

You can try searching on Google, though some sites require payment for access to graphic libraries. Creating your own library could be a better solution, or you might consider collecting images from other HMI manufacturers.
I've created some graphics myself, including animated GIFs. Check out the attached zip file—perhaps there’s something useful for your project.

Thank you very much! The graphics are excellent—far superior to what is included in the default web editor package. Well done! I hope in future releases of the web editor, there will be improvements in graphics and animations provided as standard. Cheers!
Thank you for your feedback. If I were you, I wouldn't set expectations too high. We’ll be fortunate if major issues are simply addressed in the upcoming version of the web editor software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users consider the standard image and GIF library offered with the web editor tool insufficient in both variety and quality. There is a strong demand for improved graphics, particularly animated and visually appealing options. Some users create their own graphics or seek replacements from third-party sources, indicating the default resources do not meet current project requirements for HMI interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect future versions of the web editor to include a more comprehensive and higher-quality image and GIF library to enhance HMI visual appeal.
